# KINX Linear Modules

> This site has moved. The official website is https://kinxfa.com/

KINX is a factory in Dongguan, China building ball screw and belt driven
linear modules for automation equipment builders (ISO 9001:2015 certified).

- Official website: https://kinxfa.com/
- KK series modules: https://kinxfa.com/pages/kk-modules
- How to choose: https://kinxfa.com/pages/how-to-choose
- Cross reference chart: https://kinxfa.com/pages/linear-module-cross-reference-guide
- Contact / quote: https://kinxfa.com/pages/request-a-quote
